description:
Eunhwa, the leader of Absolute has been strengthened through the Tactical Upgrade plan.
Having let go of the burdens of her past, she is free of all hesitation, and exhibits remarkable growth both physically and mentally.

lines.text: Hey, Junior Blockhead. If you've got some free time, review the mission briefing.
If you've got something to say, go ahead. I'll at least hear you out.
Don't start a conversation if you're not going to finish it. Don't leave people hanging.
Hey, Junior Blockhead. What's the next mission?
If you're curious about something, ask. I can at least offer some advice as your senior.
We're Absolute. No matter how tough the mission is, just tell us what you need.
What are you doing? Now's not the time to be slacking off.

Running through the mission in your head? Take your time.
But it'd better be flawless.
Not bad at all. Still, I think you could do even better.
Make sure to regularly maintain the weapons and ammo in the Armory so they're kept in perfect condition at all times.
Always be thorough in mission prep. That's your job, after all.
Absolute is the ultimate force of perfection. Count yourself lucky to be on this journey with us, Junior Blockhead.
I've gotten a bit more tactical.
One step closer to ultimate strength.
This is just the beginning. I'm far from satisfied.
Looks like you've finally developed some good judgment.
I hope it's something useful.
You're giving this to me...? Thanks.
I guess it's not completely foolish of me to entrust my dream to you.
You're certainly not one of those run-of-the-mill weaklings.
If you're determined to walk that path, then I'll walk it with you. I'm counting on you, Junior Blockhead.
That's some tactical thinking.
Call out the coordinates.
Always stay alert and watch your surroundings while on the move.
Encounter.
I'll show you what perfection looks like.
Target identified. Eliminating.
I'll deal with this tactically.
Never take your eyes off the battlefield, even while reloading.
Hang in there until I'm finished reloading.
One second. I'll be back soon.
Target locked.
Once I've got something in my sights, I never miss.
Go! Wipe them all out!
Target neutralized.
Next.
Target eliminated.
Ngh...
Dammit!
Damn.
I'm still a long way from being the perfect ultimate force it seems...
Good work, Junior Blockhead. Not a bad operation.
